content: The management of diabetes should be aligned with the Chronic Care Model, which prioritizes a team-based approach to care. This model emphasizes the importance of person-centered care, ensuring that the treatment plan is tailored to the individual needs of the patient. It also integrates long-term treatment strategies to address the chronic nature of diabetes. Furthermore, continuous and effective communication among all members of the healthcare team is essential to optimize patient outcomes and ensure coordinated care delivery.
